title: Machine Learning for Live-Birth Prediction After IVF/ICSI From Structured Clinical Data: A Systematic Review, Meta-Analysis, and Critical Appraisal
abstract: arXiv:2611.07124v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine-learning models predicting live birth after in vitro fertilisation (IVF) or intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) from routine clinical data report performance from near chance to near perfect. We systematically reviewed these models under PRISMA 2020, searching OpenAlex, Scopus and Web of Science to 22 October 2026, appraised them with PROBAST+AI and TRIPOD+AI, and pooled their discrimination with random-effects meta-analysis on the logit scale. translated_title: 基于结构化临床数据的机器学习预测IVF/ICSI术后活产：系统综述、荟萃分析与批判性评估
translated_abstract: 利用常规临床数据预测体外受精（IVF）或卵胞浆内单精子注射（ICSI）后活产的机器学习模型，其报告的性能从接近随机水平到接近完美不等。我们在PRISMA 2020指导下对这些模型进行了系统综述，检索了OpenAlex、Scopus和Web of Science数据库（截至2026年10月22日），采用PROBAST+AI和TRIPOD+AI对其进行质量评估，并在logit尺度上通过随机效应荟萃分析汇总其判别能力。我们定义了决定模型输出含义的要素（决策点、终点、分析单位、数据来源），并按模型家族、决策点和验证设计对纳入的48项研究进行了分类映射。仅在内部评估的模型汇总后的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）为0.814，而在后期时段或其他中心进行评估的模型AUC为0.756（95%预测区间0.546-0.889），非高偏倚风险的研究AUC为0.764；两者均……
tldr: 本系统综述与荟萃分析对48项研究进行批判性评估后发现，机器学习预测IVF/ICSI后活产的模型在内部验证时AUC可达0.814，但在外部验证时降至0.756，表明现有模型泛化能力有限。
en_tdlr: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 48 studies found that machine learning models predicting live birth after IVF/ICSI achieve a pooled AUC of 0.814 in internal validation but only 0.756 in external validation, indicating limited generalizability of existing models.
